categories.main_business_segments: Ehime Bank operates primarily in two business segments: banking and leasing. The banking segment includes deposit-taking, lending, domestic and foreign exchange, and related financial services, while the leasing segment is handled by its subsidiary, Himegin Lease, providing leasing solutions. Additional group companies offer IT services, credit card operations, and ship finance support. The bank also engages in venture capital and regional revitalization investment through affiliated funds.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The bank leverages advanced IT systems for banking operations, including a new AP platform for productivity and digital transformation (DX). It utilizes robust risk management frameworks, digital banking channels (such as internet and mobile banking), and has invested in fintech partnerships and digital branches. The group also emphasizes secure transaction processing, compliance, and data-driven decision-making in its financial services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ehime Bank primarily serves individuals, SMEs, and local governments in the Shikoku region, with a focus on Ehime Prefecture. Its customer base includes manufacturing, shipping, agriculture, and service industries, as well as retail clients. The bank also supports regional revitalization and sustainability initiatives, targeting both traditional and emerging sectors in the local economy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The bank's core operations are concentrated in Ehime Prefecture and the broader Shikoku region, with an extensive branch network in western Japan. It maintains a limited presence in other regions, including branches in major cities such as Tokyo and Osaka. The vast majority of its assets, revenues, and physical infrastructure are located within Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ehime Bank operates as a downstream financial services provider, directly interfacing with end customers (individuals, businesses, and public entities). It acts as a financial intermediary, supplying capital, financial products, and advisory services to the regional economy. The bank also supports upstream and midstream sectors through lending and investment activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening 'Financial Plus One' consulting and fee-based businesses, enhancing operational efficiency through digital transformation, and advancing sustainability management. The bank is investing in human capital, DX, and ESG-related initiatives, with a focus on regional co-creation, governance, and climate change response. It aims to increase ROE, maintain capital adequacy, and expand ESG lending, targeting 90 billion yen in cumulative ESG loans by FY2026.
categories.revenue_model: The bank generates revenue primarily from interest income on loans and securities, as well as fees from deposit, lending, and settlement services. Additional income streams include leasing, credit card operations, and investment gains. Fee-based and consulting businesses are being expanded to diversify revenue beyond traditional interest margins.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ehime Bank is positioned as a leading regional bank in Ehime Prefecture, competing with other regional banks, credit unions, and national banks operating in western Japan. Its main competitors include Iyo Bank and other local financial institutions. The bank differentiates itself through deep regional ties, a comprehensive branch network, and a focus on local industry support and sustainability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of March 2025, Ehime Bank has total consolidated assets of approximately 2.96 trillion yen and annual consolidated ordinary income of 66.1 billion yen. Net profit attributable to parent shareholders was 5.7 billion yen, with a capital adequacy ratio of 8.53%. The bank has shown stable but modest growth in assets and profits, with a focus on maintaining soundness and steady dividend increases.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ehime Bank emphasizes its role as a trusted regional financial partner, supporting the development of local industries and communities. Its value proposition centers on personalized consulting, comprehensive financial solutions, and a commitment to sustainability and regional revitalization. The bank differentiates itself through strong local relationships, digital innovation, and proactive ESG initiatives.
